name: Cross-sectional neutral momentum — short leg (bottom-rank laggards)
rationale: Mirror of the long-leaders leg (xsec-neutral-momentum-long-leg.json). Short the relative weakness laggards — assets whose N-day return ranks in the bottom percentile of the screened universe at bar close. Paired with the long-leaders leg the two form a market-neutral book: market beta cancels and the residual is the cross-sectional momentum premium on both sides (Jegadeesh–Titman 1993). Shorting laggards via the perp short prevents them from being crowded out by spot-only constraints. Entry: rank BELOW a fitted bottom-rank ceiling (laggard) AND NOT in an excessively negative funding regime (extremely negative funding means longs already bailed — fade overcrowded shorts). Vol ceiling same as the long leg for symmetry. Exit: rank recovers above a fitted recovery floor (laggard reverting, signal dead) OR stop/TP fires. No magic numbers.
catalyst: Cross-sectional momentum: bottom-ranked laggards continue to underperform at weekly-monthly horizon — short the losers.
